test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation focusing on the underlined segment.

The modern era statistics data __provides useful advantage__ to the players at competent level.

options.text: Cost an arm and a leg

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Grist to the mill '.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate idiom of the underlined segment of given sentence is:** 'Grist to the mill '. **(किसी काम का होना, उपयोगी होना)
 
• The idiom ** '****Grist to the mill'** means it is useful for a particular purpose or helps support someone's point of view.
 
 
• **Example**: *The press desperately needs new information, and everything we do is grist to the mill__.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'****Cost an arm and a leg'** means extremely expensive. (बहुत महंगा होना)
 
• **'Put something on ice**' means to postpone something. (किसी चीज़ को कुछ समय के लिए टाल देना)
 
• **'****Play it by ear'** means to decide what to do when you know what is happening, rather than planning in advance. (बिना योजना के काम करना, परिस्थिति के अनुसार काम करना)
